left: Walk verdict not confirmed: room check reports 'no way in' because the back hall and shell walls are stubs in this copy. Re-run `mcd room` on the merged build to confirm entry x42 z15 -> x43 z15 -> x45 z15 reaches the bed head and the table.

plan.md lists x42 z14 and x42 z16 as doorway cells ('D' in the plan grid), while the back hall occupies x41..42 z15..16. Whether the room has extra openings at x43 z16 (through the back hall) or x42 z14 (into the hearth) needs settling in the shell or plan Notes; the table at x43 z16 would block one of them.
The table is a fence plus top slab (table_set), so its top stands at y5, about 2 blocks high. That follows plan.md, but it reads tall for a bedroom table. The table lamp is at y5 on it.

No candle, carpet, flower pot or chest in palette.json, so the room has no soft decor (a flower pot on the barrel would be the natural addition if the palette gains it). Light comes from the stove and the table lamp only.

elements.md item 'beds NE/SE/SW against outer walls' covers four rooms; only the SE bed is built here, so I did not tick it. Pyramid stairs, the hearth mass and the stove mantle belong to other parts.

waste.cost: one plan read plus reasoning about the wall line
